prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: preview-only visual direction sketch for a desktop café operations application
Primary request: Create a deliberately unfinished flat matte UI direction sketch, clearly exploratory rather than a polished product screenshot. Show DUMA as a linked stack of index-card workspaces for running café operations.
Scene/backdrop: landscape desktop application frame, 1536×1024 composition, mostly warm white canvas.
Subject: compact left sidebar; a clearly visible back path; several overlapping and linked index-card workspaces; editable task cards; direct-manipulation controls such as small handles, toggles, drag affordances and terse toolbar marks. Use tiny 5–7px corner radii throughout. Cards should feel compact, practical and operational, never oversized.
Style/medium: flat matte digital design sketch, low-to-medium fidelity, rough direction board, restrained Swiss/industrial interface character, sparse stipple-gray texture used only as a sketch layer. Not photorealistic and not a polished screenshot.
Composition/framing: full landscape desktop frame, dense but legible working area, narrow sidebar, card stack occupying most of canvas, visible relationships between workspaces and a periwinkle selection layer highlighting one active card or linked workspace.
Color palette: exactly anchored to #FCFCFA warm white, #171717 near-black, #C9C8C2 stipple gray, #6A7FD1 periwinkle accent.
Text (verbatim): Only these two phrases may be legible anywhere: "DUMA" and "Run the shift clearly". Render those exactly. All other interface text must be greeked into abstract bars, dots, scribbles, or placeholder marks with no readable words or numbers.
Constraints: intentionally unfinished; flat matte; small corners; compact sidebar; visible back path; editable compact task cards; direct manipulation; one periwinkle selection layer; no other legible text; no watermark.
Avoid: fake vintage Mac logos, excessive pixel nostalgia, emojis, glassmorphism, gradients, bento metrics, oversized cards, photorealism, shiny surfaces, browser chrome, device mockup, marketing landing-page composition.
